On-Call Rotation Planner

Plan a fair round-robin on-call rotation: enter the team, pick a start date and number of weeks, get the full schedule with per-person totals and CSV export.

📖 How to use

  1. Type one team member per line.
  2. Pick the rotation start date, weeks per turn and total weeks.
  3. Press Generate for the round-robin schedule with exact date ranges.
  4. Download the CSV or copy the schedule to share with the team.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the rotation assigned?

Strict round-robin: member 1 takes the first turn, member 2 the second, and so on, wrapping back to member 1. Everyone gets equal turns over a full cycle.

What if the weeks don't divide evenly?

The schedule simply continues the rotation — the totals row shows exactly how many weeks each person covers, so any imbalance is visible.

Can I skip holidays?

The planner assigns continuous turns. For holiday overrides, generate the CSV, then adjust the affected rows in a spreadsheet.
